actions.action: Loosen the root ball by teasing the roots apart or making vertical cuts / shaving the outer layer
Repot into fast-draining mix (cactus mix or a 50/50 blend with potting soil, or add perlite/sand), sizing up only slightly
Make sure the pot has a drainage hole and isn't sitting in a saucer that holds water
Check soil moisture with a finger or skewer and water when the top 1-2 inches are dry
Trim dead brown stems lightly without cutting into bare wood
Move the plant out of harsh afternoon sun for a few days
If overwintering in the garage, set up a timed grow lamp for 12-14 hours
Optionally bring the plant in during rain

reason: The answer's main diagnosis is root-binding, with drought stress mentioned only as a possibility. It does not point to the terracotta pot drying the plant out. It also tells the owner to keep the terracotta, discourages plastic and recommends a fast-draining cactus mix, which would worsen the confirmed drying-out problem.
